sloka: स सम्ज्ञाअमुपलब्यैव दीर्घमुष्णम् च निःससन् ।कौसल्याम् पार्श्वतो दृष्ट्वा ततश्चिन्तामुपागमत् ॥२-६२-३॥
transliteration: sa samjñāamupalabyaiva dīrghamuṣṇam ca niḥsasan ।kausalyām pārśvato dṛṣṭvā tataścintāmupāgamat ॥2-62-3॥

translations.english: When he regained his senses, the king heaved deep, hot sighs. Seeing Kausalya by his side he relapsed into a state of anxiety.
